(3) The man stands in the aisle of the plane, looking up at the overhead bins. He is wearing blue shorts and a blue short-sleeved button-up shirt. (5) A screen recording of a mobile device shows the 'Find My' application displaying a map of Suvarnabhumi Airport with an icon of AirPods Pro.
